families.name: Server rack 42U (and doors)
families.summary: The 42U rack and its door variants, from the first mockups to the placed, fracture-ready block with PDU rails. Same three-quarter front framing where possible.

stages.label: Mockup v1
stages.note: First look at the open-frame, split-front and split-front-and-rear rack variants; a throwaway visual spike, not a game asset.

stages.label: Mockup v2
stages.note: Racks re-styled to Keen material roles, with player paint (black, Keen gray, blue) and the three door variants joined flush in a row.

stages.label: Core Task 3: first rack export
stages.note: First 42U open-frame model. It ended up 4 cells (1.0 m) wide so a 2-cell server can be centered with mountable sides (Ruling 6); the visual audit then listed four findings (empty side slabs, slots reading as drawers, tick noise, dense finger combs).

stages.label: Core Task 9: door racks
stages.note: Split-front and split-front-and-rear variants with hinged perforated doors; fix round 1 reworked the fan tray and the recessed door handle after the visual audit.

stages.label: Visual pass 1
stages.note: Feet, stickers and a static fan tray on the full racks; the 42U side panels stayed plain because the model was at its triangle cap.

stages.label: Visual pass 2
stages.note: Side detail moved into a static RackSide subpart (about 4.4k triangles freed): side hatch, placard, coolant pipes, flow meter and vent.

stages.label: Fracture refinement (T9c)
stages.note: Racks received seam caps and their own Deformed damaged models (42U 8 zones, 24U 4 zones) following the vanilla fracture guide.

stages.label: In-game fix: decal z-fighting
stages.note: Decals on the rack side and the door meeting edge flickered in game; they were lifted and the racks re-exported.

stages.label: In-game fix: servers placeable
stages.note: Front/rear occupancy removed and an invisible 2 cm rear stop added so a server seats on the rail mounts.

stages.label: In-game fix: placement aim diagram
stages.note: Diagnosis of why servers could not be placed: front and rear zone occupancy enclosed the 42U slots so the placer ray never reached them.

stages.label: Room merge: rails and PDU strips
stages.note: After the room merge: containment rail, zero-U PDU strips and a neutral placard on the racks, re-exported.

families.name: Servers (deco and functional)
families.summary: Rack servers from the mockup lineup through the deco blades, the functional Timer/Event/Status/UPS/KVM/Programmable blades, visual passes, fracture models and the final lineup.

stages.label: Mockup v2: server lineup
stages.note: All servers labeled: KVM closed and open, UPS with a cell, the functional blades and the deco compute/storage/switch/blank blades.

stages.label: Core Task 4: first deco servers
stages.note: Compute, storage, switch and blank blades, three cells deep (Ruling 7) with rack ears that may overhang the cells (Ruling 8).

stages.label: Core Task 6: functional blades
stages.note: Timer, event controller and status display servers with readable faces and lamps; they mount without a front face (Ruling 12).

stages.label: Core Task 7: UPS
stages.note: 12U UPS with the cell bay modeled to match vanilla Battery50; the second cell bay opens on the back (Ruling 13).

stages.label: Core Task 8: KVM drawer
stages.note: KVM with a pop-out drawer and screen driven by a Working-state animation; Ruling 15 added an On/Off toggle so it follows the player.

stages.label: Visual pass 1
stages.note: Layered lids, sides and rears; the Compute server gained a fan wall, the Switch patch cables.

stages.label: Hero lineup (core)
stages.note: The full server lineup after the visual passes, in the hero set.

stages.label: Plan 4: scripted KVM motion (slide)
stages.note: The scripted KVM sequence: the drawer slides out first (t = 0.5 s, 0.312 m travel), then the lid lifts.

stages.label: Plan 4: scripted KVM motion (open)
stages.note: Fully open at 2.5 s: drawer 0.450 m, lid 100 degrees. Open takes about 2.35 s, close 1.78 s and a fast stow 0.60 s.

stages.label: Fracture refinement (T9c)
stages.note: Servers became three-zone breakables (critical core, front, rear) with dented Damaged models capped at about twice the Fractured triangles.

families.name: Cable trays
families.summary: Overhead cable trays: straights, bends, tees, crossings, reducers and drops, from the mockup to the capped, breakable, length-costed set.

stages.label: Mockup v1: tray joint
stages.note: Tray density, tee and bundle routing explored in the first mockup spike.

stages.label: Mockup v2: reducer and long drop
stages.note: Two rows across a 1.5 m aisle with a T, a reducer full to moderate, drops into full racks and a long drop to a half rack.

stages.label: Plan 2 Task 3: junction plans
stages.note: Tee turns in grouped bundles (a real tray tee, Ruling P2-18) and a cross saddle; still a plan sheet.

stages.label: Plan 2 Task 4: first 3D export
stages.note: First built straights with strapped data bundles in a wire basket; the audit found the paintable basket and cables always matched in color and the cables read as smooth pipes.

stages.label: Plan 2 Task 2: lane plans
stages.note: Lane planning diagram (2D plan sheets, Pillow-based) for the density ladder and reducer chain, before any 3D model existed.

stages.label: Plan 2 Task 4: fix round 1
stages.note: Basket and hardware switched to fixed brushed metal with paintable cables, a phase-locked 60 degree / 0.5 m lay and cinched straps (Ruling P2-21).

stages.label: Plan 2 Task 7: junction grid
stages.note: Tees, crosses and the X-OVER saddle with ties laid over a rack row.

stages.label: Plan 2 Task 8: drops and hangers
stages.note: Drop waterfalls over a formed guide, grommets landing in the rack brush plates, and rod hangers.

stages.label: Plan 2 Task 10: visual pass
stages.note: Free-end caps on 34 of 38 pieces, a breakout tie for the M0 branch and radial normals to remove lay-twist banding.

stages.label: Plan 2 Task 11: mockup 05b recreated
stages.note: The finished run viewed from the mockup 05b camera, with drops into a rack row.

stages.label: Fracture refinement (T9c)
stages.note: All 34 breakable trays have 2 to 4 fracture zones and Damaged models; trays are structural with no critical zone (Ruling P2-30).

families.name: Room: floor, containment and doors
families.summary: Raised floor tiles, containment roof panels and end-of-aisle sliding doors, from mockup to the contained-aisle room.

stages.label: Mockup v1: containment
stages.note: Containment glazing and doors beside a CRAC and a KVM terminal, from the first mockup.

stages.label: Mockup v2: hero aisle
stages.note: The v1 hero aisle re-styled with Keen stencils, hazard door edges and neutral lighting.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 2: room layout
stages.note: Room catalog and generated preview rooms (1.0, 1.5, 2.0 m aisles, hot and cold) built from clones; no new geometry yet.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 3: raised floor
stages.note: Solid and perforated floor tiles on pedestals, breakable with two zones (deck and understructure).

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 4: containment roof
stages.note: Frosted roof panels with LED battens that clamp to the rack rails; glazing and frame fracture separately.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 5: sliding doors
stages.note: Glass sliding door leaves in side pockets with collision only when closed; 8 fracture zones.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 5: door in the aisle
stages.note: The door seen from inside a contained cold aisle.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 11: visual pass
stages.note: Z-fight and stencil-contrast audit, contained-aisle label guidance and joint checks across floor, roof and doors.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 12: final hall
stages.note: Cold aisle in the finished two-aisle hall.

families.name: Room: CRAC, PDU and signs
families.summary: The in-row cooler, PDU cabinet and rack PDU strips, and the aisle and rack signs.

stages.label: Mockup v1: PDU and CRAC
stages.note: PDU cabinet with breakers and an emergency stop beside the containment door.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 6: CRAC
stages.note: In-row cooler built on a stripped gyroscope (power load, On/Off) with three fan rotors, a 2 s soft start, 9 fracture zones and a RUN lamp.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 8: signs
stages.note: Aisle sign, hanging aisle sign and rack label with editable LCD surfaces.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 8: rack labels in a row
stages.note: Rack labels and hanging aisle signs along a cold aisle.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 7: PDU cabinet
stages.note: PDU cabinet with two vertical breaker columns and a FEED A/B plate; rack PDU strips came with it (3 and 2 fracture zones).

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 11: CRAC service ports
stages.note: Two decorative blanked O2 / coolant service ports reusing the vanilla small conveyor-port kit part, plus a rear filter bank.

stages.label: Room merge: neutral CRAC
stages.note: After merging main into the room branch, with the neutral rack placard and re-exported racks around it.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 12: CRAC header
stages.note: Neutral CRAC header plate and controller close-up in the final hall.

families.name: Whole hall / hero shots
families.summary: The same kind of down-the-aisle view across the cycle: mockups, the core hero set, the first Plan 3 rooms and the two-aisle hall.

stages.label: Mockup v1: hero aisle
stages.note: The first hero aisle: trays overhead, containment doors at the end.

stages.label: Mockup v2: hero aisle
stages.note: Same camera, re-styled with black paint, armored corner caps, Keen stencils and neutral lighting.

stages.label: Core hero set
stages.note: First in-engine-style hero of built blocks: racks with open doors, KVM out and the UPS lit, over a cold-aisle floor stand-in.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 2: first room
stages.note: First generated 1.5 m contained cold aisle from the room catalog.

stages.label: Plan 2 Task 11: trays over the aisle
stages.note: Hero set for the cable trays: runs and drops over a rack aisle.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 11: photo 4
stages.note: Overhead view of trays, drops and racks in a room, after the camera fix.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 12: hall photo
stages.note: Down the contained aisle with CRACs and doors at the end.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 12: overhead
stages.note: Overhead of the finished two-aisle hall.

stages.label: Plan 3 Task 12: doors outside
stages.note: Both containment doors from outside, with hot and cold aisle signs.
